connector.name: MCP Bigdatacorp
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for BigDataCorp - Brazilian data enrichment + KYC (CPF/CNPJ/vehicle/property/antifraud)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-bigdatacorp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the codespar account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BIGDATACORP_ACCESS_TOKEN
env.description: AccessToken header value from the BigDataCorp dashboard

env.name: BIGDATACORP_TOKEN_ID
env.description: TokenId header paired with the access token

env.name: BIGDATACORP_API_BASE
env.description: API base URL — defaults to BigDataCorp production. Override for sandbox.
